w: Swamishri arrived in Chicago at 11.30 am. The Haveli Mahotsav was held at the new 30-acre mandir site. A wonderful mini-spiritual township with archway (Hansa dwar), assembly marquee and Haveli complex were set up. Children and teenagers welcomed Swamishri with folkdances and dignitaries offered bouquets. Swamishri performed pujan of the ornately carved main entrance and inaugurated the Haveli complex by opening the nada chhadi amidst Vedic chanting. Dignitaries split coconuts on the threshold of the Haveli complex. Swamishri then sanctified the entire Haveli complex with Lord Harikrishna Maharaj. During a brief assembly Swamishri was welcomed and presented with a proclamation by Mr. Robert Schillerstrom - Chairman of Du Page County board.

At 6.45 pm Swamishri was honored during the welcome assembly held in a marquee near the Haveli complex. Seventeen heads of Indian Organizations honored and presented proclamations to Swamishri, namely, National Federation of Indian Associations (NFIA), Federation of Indian Associations (FIA), Gujarat Cultural Association (GCA), Jain Society, etc.

w: Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees.

In the morning the devotees participated in a samuh mahapuja, praying for Swamishri’s good health. Devotees were guided through the mahapuja rituals by Narayanprasad Dave, who has been performing the mahapuja in Nairobi mandir daily for the past 35 years.

Swamishri was feverish in the morning. Despite this he offered flowers to the murti of Hanumanji and performed Hanuman pujan – a tradition on Kali Chaudas. Thereafter he performed his puja in the assembly hall.
21, 22 & 23 October 2006, London Swamishri celebrated Diwali, Annakut and New Year’s festivals.

A devotee came for darshan. He was very fond of wearing gold. Whenever he went out of the house, he would wear heavy gold ornaments around his neck, on his hands, on his wrists and everywhere. When he came this time, he said, "I have given up wearing all of it."
Pleased, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "That is right. Who do we have to show off to people? We should do what is to be shown to God."
Instead of a rajasic (worldly, showy) mindset, Swamishri naturally spoke of pleasing God through bhajan and devotion.
Pramukh Swami Maharaj sat down to offer his meal to Thakorji. During the meal, there was talk about the feelings that former President Abdul Kalam has for Swamishri.

Brahmavihari Swami said to Swamishri, "Abdul Kalam Saheb recently went to Canada. Talking to you about it on the phone, he said, 'I visited Akshardham in Toronto. I experienced that although you are in one place, you are present everywhere.'"
Having said this, Brahmavihari Swami said, "You are indeed present in all the mandirs, aren't you?"
Brushing the matter aside, Swamishri said, "Well! When there is an occasion, we do go everywhere, don't we!"
Brahmavihari Swami said, "When a person of another faith like him speaks of his own experience, he would surely not be saying something untrue!"
Hearing this, Swamishri said, "That is certainly true!"

Brahmavihari Swami continued, "Abdul Kalam Saheb has not only respect for you, but devotion too. At the Bal Mahotsav celebrated in Gandhinagar in 2004, you came all the way to his car to see Shri Kalam Saheb off. He recalls that incident every time. Your humility has touched his heart."

Speaking of another incident, Brahmavihari Swami said, "A man named Anand Shah, who studied at Harvard University, has founded a social service organisation called Indicorps. One day he came to the Ahmedabad mandir looking for you. He said, 'I received an award from the President for service to the nation, and I went to President Kalam Saheb to receive it. After giving the award, he said to me, "Meet me later." And it so happened that I met him at Ahmedabad airport itself. Abdul Kalam Saheb said to me, "You have done very good work for the nation, but if you want to do even better work, meet Pramukh Swami Maharaj." After hearing this, I have come to receive the blessings of Pramukh Swami Maharaj.'"

Today many such incidents came to mind, showing how, through his saintliness and his life full of devotion to his chosen deity and to his guru, Swamishri has come to dwell in the hearts of everyone, from the humblest person to a great personality like Dr Abdul Kalam.

Today, on the occasion of the New Year, an annakut was offered before Thakorji. Mahant Swami Maharaj went to have darshan of the annakut offered to the guru parampara. Going a little further in front of Yogibapa, he searched for something and said, "Is there no puffed rice?"
Wah, devotion to the guru! That the guru's favourite food was not in the offering immediately caught Swamishri's eye...
